original_test_intent: On an approved dedicated configuration, prove both AGFHC PCIe level-2 and DMA level-2 tests pass and each measured bandwidth exceeds its authoritative target without link, GPU or system degradation.
original_method: Identify the SUT/GPU/PCIe/DMA topology and compatible AGFHC build, confirm both recipes and their target/unit/window definitions, quiesce competing load, capture baseline link and health state, then under explicit approval run pcie_lvl2 and dma_lvl2 sequentially with complete output and monitoring; independently compare each Status and measured bandwidth to target and verify post-test link/GPU/DMA/thermal health.
manual_activity: The owner approves AGFHC recipes, targets and dedicated maintenance; an operator monitors both sequential stress runs; the owner reviews two independent measured-versus-target results and decides the verdict.
required_inputs: Compatible owner-approved AGFHC version and package
Availability and exact semantics of pcie_lvl2 and dma_lvl2
Per-recipe target bandwidth, units and measurement window
Thermal/power/link/DMA health limits, aborts and recovery access
safety_requirements: Use protected access and preserve complete stdout/stderr separately with exit status
Require explicit approval before sustained PCIe/DMA I/O
Run recipes sequentially with no competing workload
Monitor link speed/width, AER, DMA/GPU errors, thermal, power and system health
Do not infer PASS from exit code or one recipe
Stop on downtrain/loss/error/alarm/instability and do not blind-rerun
Preserve logs and never clear evidence
agent_execution_scope: Collect topology/tool/recipe/target and baseline health evidence
Validate both recipes are present and output schema is parseable
After approval run each once sequentially with continuous monitoring
Parse separate Status and measured-versus-target results and post-health
Perform no target invention, uncontrolled stress, recovery decision or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve AGFHC build, both recipes, targets and maintenance controls
Disposition either run or health anomaly and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat PCIe and DMA as separate mandatory result rows, each bound to topology, recipe version, target/unit/window and pre/post health evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit recipe/target provenance and safety monitoring while retaining both source commands and comparisons.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A passing PCIe recipe cannot substitute for DMA coverage because DMA engines, memory paths and error modes differ.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Concurrent load or downtraining can distort bandwidth, while sustained I/O can expose or worsen link/DMA instability.

project_override_considerations: If recipe naming changes, the owner must map replacements to both PCIe and DMA intents and targets. Missing dma_lvl2 or an undefined target is BLOCKED execution, not a reason to count pcie_lvl2 alone.

review_improvement: Restores the omitted DMA half and makes each bandwidth claim independently target-bound, monitored and traceable.
independent_technical_reasoning: PCIe transfer and DMA engines exercise related but non-identical paths, so one result cannot cover the other. AGFHC's Status must be paired with the actual-versus-target comparison because a process may complete while missing performance acceptance. Targets depend on topology, generation, width, transfer direction and tool window; they cannot be guessed. Sustained I/O also requires baseline/post link and error evidence to reject false performance readings caused by downtraining or concurrent load.
